summary:
Frontend-only smoke + regression testing on Expo web (viewport 390x844). All requested changes verified: Home menu now contains ONLY 'Inglés' (lang-english, with checkmark) and 'Videos' (menu-videos); the removed entries lang-spanish, lang-mixed-en-es, lang-mixed-es-en are absent (count = 0). Tapping menu-videos navigates to /videos. /videos shows two separate cards video-card-v1 and video-card-v2 with titles 'Lección 1' and 'Lección 2'; both cards render an HTML5 <video> element with native controls (2 <video> tags on page). Back button returns to Home. Regression: all 4 module cards (M1.A, M1.B, Tita I, Tita II) render on Home, and M1.A generates the English sentence 'I can see.' via generate-button (card-affirmative text = 'AFIRMATIVA

I can see.
👀'). Language is locked to English (no Spanish sense/verb strings appear in M1.A). One minor observation: the testID passed to expo-video's <VideoView> (video-player-v1/v2) is not propagated to the rendered DOM element on web, so the testIDs are not queryable — the videos themselves DO render correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: testID prop is not forwarded to the rendered DOM node on web preview, so [data-testid="video-player-v1"] / [data-testid="video-player-v2"] cannot be located by Playwright. The two <video> elements do render correctly with native controls, but strict testID-based selection is not possible. Reference: /app/frontend/app/videos.tsx:60. Suggestion: wrap the <VideoView> in a <View testID="video-player-v1"> (and v2) so a queryable wrapper exists for tests.

action_items: Optional: wrap each <VideoView> in a <View testID="video-player-v1"> / v2 wrapper in /app/frontend/app/videos.tsx so that the video-player testIDs required by the review request are queryable in tests (functional behavior is already correct).
critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings on web: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but noisy in logs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 requested checks pass, minor testID propagation caveat on VideoView noted)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://find-estasaqui.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844. Home testIDs: menu-button, module-M1.A/M1.B/Tita I/Tita II. Menu testIDs: lang-english (static View with check), menu-videos (Pressable → router.push('/videos')). Videos screen testIDs: back-button, video-card-v1, video-card-v2 (video-player-v1/v2 testIDs currently not propagated by expo-video on web). M1.A generation: generate-button → card-affirmative renders 'I can see.'
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only observation is the expo-video VideoView testID prop not reaching the DOM on web; mitigation is to wrap it in a View that carries the testID.
